verdict.rationale: Elastic ships an official MCP server (elastic/mcp-server-elasticsearch) exposing query, index, and analytics operations to agents, and a runtime probe confirms it completes a real stdio JSON-RPC handshake and can perform index/search roundtrips against a live Elasticsearch instance. Elastic also documents official 'skills' for AI coding agents to work with the stack, reinforcing an agent-facing tool-calling surface. Missing for 10: independent third-party (non-vendor) confirmation of the MCP server's analytics/aggregation coverage beyond basic query/index operations.
